name: ZeroClaw
description: Ultra-lightweight AI agent framework written in Rust with sub-10ms cold starts and under 5MB memory footprint.

env.label: Anthropic API Key
env.description: API key for Anthropic Claude models (get from console.anthropic.com); can also be configured in config.toml

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: API key for OpenAI models (get from platform.openai.com); can also be configured in config.toml

env.label: OpenRouter API Key
env.description: API key for OpenRouter models (get from openrouter.ai/keys); can also be configured in config.toml

env.label: OpenRouter Model
env.description: Model identifier for the OpenRouter default alias (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6)

env.label: Data Directory
env.description: Directory where ZeroClaw stores config and persistent data inside the container
